interpretationUnits.title: Year Pillar in the four-pillar structure
interpretationUnits.plainLanguageExplanation: This theme comes from the role of the Year Pillar, its stem Yang Wood, its branch Rat, and its relationship to the day reference Yang Metal under the month context Tiger. When the role, season and day reference support one another, a constructive expression may be: Rat branch in the recorded four-pillar structure is one bounded part of the recorded BaZi structure. It becomes useful only when read with its pillar role and the other admitted structural context; by itself it does not establish personality, identity, fate, or an outcome. Recorded cycle context is one bounded part of the recorded BaZi structure. It becomes useful only when read with its pillar role and the other admitted structural context; by itself it does not establish personality, identity, fate, or an outcome. Year pillar is one bounded part of the recorded BaZi structure. It becomes useful only when read with its pillar role and the other admitted structural context; by itself it does not establish personality, identity, fate, or an outcome. When one layer is overemphasised, the same structure may become narrow or reactive; this remains an alternative expression, not a verdict.
